goal: Preserve historical failures as precise executable regression evidence.
observed: Regression target selection treats any two files with the same basename as equivalent.
expected: When a regression records a repository-relative path, it should run only for that logical path; basename matching should be reserved for callers that provide only a basename.
divergence: The current _case_matches_target predicate returns true for exact normalized path equality OR basename equality, so pkg_a/router.py can select a case recorded for pkg_b/router.py.
cause: The regression gate lacks a distinction between path-qualified and basename-only target requests.
proposed_change: Change matching so path-qualified requested targets require exact normalized path equality while basename-only requests retain basename compatibility.
expected_improvement: Path-specific regression memory stops leaking across unrelated same-named modules without breaking existing basename-only gate callers.
risks: A caller may currently pass a path-qualified target while relying on accidental basename fallback.
Candidate-file invocation must preserve the logical repository path instead of replacing it with a temporary workspace path.
falsification_test: Create two recorded cases targeting pkg_a/router.py and pkg_b/router.py. Request pkg_a/router.py and assert only the first loads; request router.py and assert both load for backward-compatible basename-only behavior.

evidence.observation: _case_matches_target currently returns case_target == requested or Path(case_target).name == Path(requested).name.
RegressionCase.target_file is normalized and persisted as a logical target, so directory identity is available to the gate.
